user_story: As a guest, I want booking creation to fail if any required field is missing so that incomplete bookings are not saved.

positive.title: Successful booking creation with all required fields
steps: Navigate to the booking creation form.
Fill in all required fields accurately.
positive.expected_result: The booking is created successfully and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Booking creation fails with missing required field
steps: Navigate to the booking creation form.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the missing required field and the booking is not created.

edge.title: Booking creation fails with invalid data in required fields
steps: Navigate to the booking creation form.
Fill in a required field with invalid data (e.g., wrong format for date).
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating the invalid data and the booking is not created.
